hero.label: Notes from the in-between
hero.heading: Technology keeps changing. The difficult part rarely does.

content.text: Three decades in the room where delivery
Where the plan meets the people.
And now the new era greatest question: what we must not delegate to AI?

belief.label: 01 — I Believe
statements: AI should be used. Not abused. Do not let it use you. Do not let it abuse you.
Complexity deserves nuance. Decisions require clarity.
The technology may be unprecedented. Many of the questions are not.

Information is abundant. Too much. Judgment is not. Never enough.
Guess what belongs to AI, and what belongs to human?

darkMatter.label: Dark Matter
darkMatter.heading: 02 —  The work between the work.
narrative: In difficult projects, you  often miss the connection the pieces that were not supposed to be disconnected in the first place. Technology and business, decisions and consequences, formal roles and real responsibility, tasks and final goal
It seems that everything is ok. It's not. The system is starting to pull apart. You need... THE DARK MATTER
darkMatter.closingThought: Help other people learning how to see the whole. Clearly
darkMatter.supportingText: Now I can leave. But I think they will miss Giorgino, anyway

content.text: Not content. A place to follow a line of thought long enough to see where it goes.

running.label: 04 — The Running Project
running.heading: And then I tried to build it.
running.body: A real running application, built substantially with AI coding agents. The concept, constraints, priorities and decisions remain human.
running.placeholder: A reminder that a body is not a spreadsheet.
running.supportingStatement: Signal over noise. Assistance without surrender.

human.label: 06 — Human
human.heading: I am interested in what holds — and what slips through.

content.text: Technology is only one way I pay attention. The rest belongs to the world
